waypoints.name: Eldorado Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From SR 20 at Marblemount, cross the Skagit River bridge onto the Cascade River Road and drive about 20 miles east, paved for the first 10 then rough gravel, to the Eldorado parking area on the right near milepost 20. The climbers' trail leaves the road a short walk west of the lot. A free backcountry permit from the park is required for any overnight stay.
